mapper.select: /* DeliveryChgMapper.getDeliveryDocNo : 배송지변경신고 추출 배송지변경 번호: 특송부호(6) +년도(4) +일련번호(8) TODO 특송부호 prefix 받아야함*/ SELECT CONCAT('ABCDEF',CONVERT(CHAR(4), GETDATE(), 112),CONCAT(REPLICATE('0', 8 - LEN(num)), num)) AS ediDocNo FROM ( SELECT ISNULL(MAX(SUBSTRING(EDI_DOC_NO,11,8)),0) + 1 AS num FROM TB_EDI_LINKED WHERE SUBSTRING(EDI_DOC_NO,1,10) = CONCAT('ABCDEF',CONVERT(CHAR(4), GETDATE(), 112)) ) A

/* DeliveryChgMapper.selectEdiCreateChk : 배송지변경신고 생성유무 체크 */ SELECT COUNT(CASE WHEN ISNULL(DELIVERY_DOC_NO, '') != '' THEN 1 END) AS DOC_NO_CNT ,COUNT(CASE WHEN ISNULL(SIMPLE_REPORT_DATE, '') = '' THEN 1 END) AS DATE_NULL_CNT FROM TB_ECM_OD_ADDITIONAL WHERE OD_JOB_NO IN(#{item.odJobNo})

/* DeliveryChgMapper.selectDeliveryChgList : 배송지변경신고 일괄변경 리스트조회 */ SELECT od.BOUND ,od.BOUND_TYPE ,od.OD_JOB_NO ,od.MBL_NO ,od.HBL_NO ,( SELECT TOP 1 A.POD_JOB_NO FROM( SELECT POD_JOB_NO FROM TB_ECM_POD WHERE OD_JOB_NO = od.OD_JOB_NO AND POD_STATUS = 'ECM420' UNION ALL SELECT POD_JOB_NO FROM TB_ECM_POD_04 WHERE OD_JOB_NO = od.OD_JOB_NO AND POD_STATUS = 'ECM420' ) A ) AS POD_JOB_NO FROM TB_ECM_OD od WHERE od.OD_JOB_NO IN(#{item.odJobNo})

/* DeliveryChgMapper.selectHblValidate3 : hbl유효성체크 */ SELECT COUNT(OD_JOB_NO) AS CNT FROM TB_ECM_OD WHERE HBL_NO = LTRIM(RTRIM(#{hblNo}))
AND MBL_NO = LTRIM(RTRIM(#{mblNo}))
